name: Architectural Awareness Service
purpose: maintain continuous, always-current architectural integrity assessment
governance: architecture policy; continuously monitors every artefact/model change; produces real-time conformance status and drift alerts
success: no undetected divergence exceeding tolerance

name: Architectural Obsolescence Forecast Service
purpose: forecast when a pattern will fail to scale, before it breaks
governance: architecture policy; also draws on usage/load telemetry; produces an obsolescence forecast
success: forecast pattern replaced before failure occurs

name: Architectural Review Service
purpose: evaluate proposed solutions for architectural integrity and organisational alignment
governance: enterprise architecture policy, security standard, technology standard, regulatory obligation; also draws on the relevant architectural constraint; output also folds in a recommendation alongside the architectural decision record
success: decision approved, risk addressed, traceability established

name: Asset Reuse Service
purpose: identify and leverage existing components, libraries or patterns instead of building from scratch

service_level.label: Security and quality vetting of the reused asset

governance: reuse policy, licensing and security vetting standard; also draws on the requirement/design need and the organisational asset inventory
success: reusable asset adopted in place of new construction, or explicitly rejected with documented rationale

name: Availability Assurance Service
purpose: keep deployed systems reliable and observable
governance: SLA/operational policy; also produces live performance data
success: agreed availability target met

name: BA Approach Definition Service
purpose: determine the appropriate elicitation technique, deliverable set, and stakeholder-engagement plan for a given engagement before any elicitation begins

service_level.label: Fitness of approach to context (right-sized, neither over- nor under-specified for the engagement)

governance: organisational BA standard, Template's commissioning parameters; also draws on the governing Objective statement, Template/commissioning context, stakeholder complexity, and regulatory context
success: approach approved by sponsoring authority before elicitation begins

name: Baseline Management Service
purpose: preserve version integrity of every engineering artefact
governance: configuration-management policy; also draws on tracked artefact versions
success: baseline reproducible on demand

name: Capability Benchmarking Service
purpose: compare this organisation's capability maturity against every other capability instance the platform hosts
governance: multi-tenancy/data-sharing policy (Book 3 Ch.42); also produces an identified improvement opportunity alongside the benchmark report
success: benchmark-identified opportunity acted upon

name: Capability Realignment Service
purpose: keep the capability portfolio aligned to shifting objectives
governance: strategic-governance policy; also draws on revised or superseded Objectives and market/business signal; also produces a realignment recommendation
success: capability portfolio reflects current Objectives

name: Capability Self-Optimisation Service
purpose: improve a capability's own effectiveness without waiting for external direction
governance: capability-ownership policy; draws on capability performance evidence; produces an applied optimisation and improvement record
success: optimisation improves measured capability metric without introducing regression

name: Capability Stewardship Service
purpose: ensure a capability continues to serve the organisation effectively over time, distinct from exercising it day to day

service_level.label: The five dimensions §6.13 names for capability measurement itself — outcome consistency

governance: capability-ownership mandate, strategic-governance policy — explicitly not line-management authority (§6.11: "should not be confused with traditional line management"); also draws on capability performance and telemetry data, evidence accumulated through service delivery, the current Objective set, and the existing capability portfolio
success: measurable increase in capability maturity over time, and every identified gap either addressed or explicitly accepted as strategic debt with a named owner

name: Change Evaluation and Scheduling Service
purpose: evaluate, approve, schedule and coordinate a proposed change based on its risk and potential conflict with other concurrent changes

service_level.label: Consistency of risk assessment across similar changes
Accuracy of conflict detection (no two conflicting changes approved into the same window)
Decision timeliness relative to the change's urgency

governance: change-management policy, risk-classification standard; also draws on the current schedule of other approved or pending changes and risk-classification criteria; output also includes a conflict assessment against other in-flight changes
success: the change proceeds without causing an avoidable conflict or incident, or is correctly rejected or rescheduled before it can

name: Component Integration Service
purpose: combine separately constructed components into a coherent, working whole
governance: integration standard, interface/API policy
success: integrated whole functions coherently and is accepted into system-level verification

name: Configuration Conformance Service
purpose: verify deployed configuration matches declared intent at all times
governance: configuration-management policy; also draws on live environment state; produces a drift alert and remediation recommendation
success: drift remediated before incident occurs

name: Continuous Confidence Service
purpose: maintain an always-current confidence assessment rather than a point-in-time one
governance: quality policy; continuously monitors every code/test change
success: confidence score never stale at any release decision

name: Continuous Documentation Service
purpose: keep documentation synchronised with current system state at all times
governance: documentation standard; continuously monitors every artefact change
success: no documentation ever found stale at audit

name: Continuous Learning Service
purpose: keep the capability-improvement loop running without waiting for retrospectives

service_level.label: Cycle time between evidence and improvement

governance: organisational-learning policy; draws on evidence generated by every service interaction; produces a capability-improvement recommendation
success: measurable capability-maturity increase over time

name: Continuous Requirement Conformance Service
purpose: keep the requirement baseline validated as it evolves, not only at baseline-freeze

service_level.label: Zero-lag detection of newly introduced conflict

governance: requirements-management policy; continuously monitors every requirement change; produces a continuous validation status
success: no invalid requirement reaches architecture undetected

name: Continuous Security Posture Service
purpose: maintain whole-portfolio security exposure awareness continuously
governance: security policy; continuously monitors every code/infrastructure change; produces a live posture status
success: no critical exposure undetected between assessments (there are none — it's continuous)

name: Continuous Trace Awareness Service
purpose: keep every artefact relationship current without manual maintenance
governance: traceability policy; continuously monitors every artefact/decision change
success: full trace path reconstructible on demand

name: Coverage Gap Forecast Service
purpose: identify defect classes current coverage would fail to catch, before they occur
governance: quality policy; produces a predicted coverage gap
success: predicted gap closed before associated defect class occurs

name: Cross-Enterprise Impact Analysis Service
purpose: assess the consequence of a proposed change across the entire enterprise before it's made
governance: change-control policy
success: no unanticipated downstream impact discovered post-change

name: Cross-Project Knowledge Synthesis Service
purpose: synthesise reusable understanding across every concurrent and historical project
governance: knowledge acquisition-scope policy (cf. Book 3 Ch.16 §12)
success: synthesised knowledge reused by at least one other project

name: Cross-System Pattern Recognition Service
purpose: identify structural weakness in one system by reasoning across every system's architecture simultaneously
governance: architecture policy
success: pattern confirmed applicable and addressed

name: Data Pipeline Engineering Service
purpose: deliver a data pipeline that moves and transforms data reliably, with evidence of its own quality
governance: data-management policy, data-quality standard
success: the pipeline's data-quality evidence is accepted as sufficient to trust downstream consumers

name: Decision Rationale Service
purpose: keep every significant decision connected to its supporting evidence and outcome
governance: decision-governance policy; also draws on supporting evidence; produces an explainable decision trace
success: any decision explainable on demand without reconstruction effort

name: Decision Validation Service
purpose: ensure engineering decisions comply with policy before taking effect
governance: decision-governance policy; also draws on the proposed decision itself and the applicable policy it is evaluated against
success: decision recorded with traceable rationale

name: Defect Resolution Service
purpose: track, triage, prioritise and close defects, functional and security, as a standing lifecycle
governance: defect-management policy, severity-classification standard; also draws on severity and impact criteria
success: defect closed and verified resolved, or explicitly deferred with documented rationale and owner

name: Deployment Governance Service
purpose: determine and coordinate readiness for deployment
governance: release policy, change-control standard; also produces a release recommendation alongside the deployment coordination record
success: release deployed without rollback

name: Detailed Design Service
purpose: produce the detailed, element-level design of a specific component before construction begins

service_level.label: Conformance to the architectural constraints it was handed
Completeness (no significant design decision left for the developer to invent unspecified)

governance: design standard, architecture-conformance policy
success: the design is accepted as ready for construction — a developer can implement against it without needing to make further design decisions

name: Domain Model Conformance Service
purpose: detect the moment the domain model diverges from actual business behaviour
governance: Ontology policy; also draws on live business signal; produces a drift alert
success: drift corrected before it propagates into requirements

name: Domain Model Service
purpose: give the organisation a shared model of the business it serves
governance: Ontology Model policy; draws on business documentation, stakeholder interviews, and existing domain artefacts
success: domain experts ratify the model

name: Engineering Review Service
purpose: statically examine a completed artefact for defects and standard-conformance without executing it

service_level.label: Reviewer independence from the artefact's producer

governance: review policy, separation-of-duties requirement; also draws on the completed artefact under review, code or design
success: artefact approved for progression, or findings resolved and re-reviewed

name: Engineering Risk Forecast Service
purpose: forecast engineering risk before it materialises
governance: risk-management policy; also draws on historical risk/outcome data and current engineering state
success: forecast risk actually materialising within predicted window, tracked

name: Firmware Engineering Service
purpose: deliver firmware that behaves correctly within the target hardware's real constraints
governance: embedded systems engineering standard, safety/regulatory obligation where applicable
success: firmware verified against the real or simulated target hardware and accepted for integration

name: Fix Propagation Service
purpose: propagate a fix or improvement to every place it applies, instantly
governance: change-control policy; draws on an applied fix and the codebase inventory; produces propagation candidates and applied propagations
success: all valid instances remediated

name: Incident Anticipation Service
purpose: recognise precursor conditions of a future incident before it manifests
governance: operational policy; continuously monitors telemetry; produces an anticipatory alert
success: anticipated incident prevented or mitigated pre-emptively

name: Knowledge Discovery Service
purpose: reconstruct engineering understanding not currently captured
governance: knowledge validation policy; also draws on legacy artefacts and historical decisions
success: recovered knowledge validated and published

name: Legacy Knowledge Reconstruction Service
purpose: reconstruct disappeared engineering knowledge from legacy artefacts

service_level.label: Accuracy against ground truth where verifiable

governance: knowledge validation policy; also draws on historical records and operational history
success: reconstructed knowledge validated by domain review

name: Model Training & Evaluation Service
purpose: produce a trained model that meets its defined quality, bias, and performance objective, with evidence that it does

service_level.label: Evaluation coverage across defined quality/bias/performance criteria
Known bias and limitations disclosed in the Model Card

governance: model-governance policy, responsible-AI standard
success: the model's evaluation record is accepted as sufficient to authorise serving it

name: Objective Alignment Service
purpose: continuously check ongoing engineering work still serves its stated Objective
governance: strategic-governance policy; continuously monitors the active Objective and current engineering state; also produces a drift alert
success: drift corrected or Objective formally revised before divergence compounds

name: Operational Intelligence Service
purpose: convert production experience into reusable understanding
governance: organisational-learning policy; also draws on live telemetry and operational evidence
success: knowledge item published and referenced by future decisions

name: Organisational Reasoning Service
purpose: let engineering decisions emerge from accumulated organisational understanding rather than isolated discussion
governance: decision-governance policy; also draws on accumulated evidence; produces a reasoned recommendation
success: recommendation accepted or explicitly overridden with rationale

name: Persistent Compliance Service
purpose: evaluate every change against applicable policy the instant it occurs
governance: every active Compliance Pack's policy; continuously monitors every architectural/implementation/deployment/operational event; produces continuous compliance status and violation alerts
success: no compliance violation reaches release undetected

name: Policy Consistency Service
purpose: detect latent contradiction across every active policy/standard/decision
governance: governance policy itself; draws on the full policy corpus
success: no unresolved conflict reaches enforcement

name: Problem Elimination Service
purpose: maintain a standing record of known-but-unresolved root causes and systematically eliminate them, independent of any single incident
governance: problem-management policy; also draws on operational telemetry trend; also produces the eliminated root causes themselves alongside the known-error record
success: recurring root cause permanently eliminated, confirmed by absence of recurrence over a defined period

name: Quality Assurance Service
purpose: provide justified confidence the implementation satisfies specification
governance: quality policy, compliance standard
success: confidence sufficient to justify release

name: Release Risk Forecast Service
purpose: maintain an ongoing, updating risk prediction for an in-progress release
governance: release policy; also draws on the full history of prior release outcomes; produces a continuously updated risk score
success: risk score correlates with actual post-release incident rate

name: Requirement Prioritisation Service
purpose: rank validated requirements by relative value, risk and dependency to guide delivery sequencing
governance: prioritisation policy, sponsor approval threshold; also draws on business value criteria and the dependency graph
success: sponsor/product owner approves the ranked backlog

name: Requirement Validation Service
purpose: confirm discovered requirements are correct, complete and agreed
governance: change-control policy; also draws on acceptance criteria
success: requirement baseline approved and frozen

name: Requirements Analysis Service
purpose: decompose and structure elicited requirements into a coherent set, resolving gaps and conflicts before modelling or validation begins

service_level.label: Traceability from each detailed requirement back to its source statement

governance: requirements-management policy, decomposition and traceability standard; also draws on stakeholder context and constraints
success: the analysed requirement set is accepted as ready for modelling (#4) or validation (#3) without needing further raw elicitation

name: Requirements Discovery Service
purpose: Surface stakeholder needs before design begins
governance: requirements-management policy; also draws on stakeholder access
success: sponsor confirms requirement set represents intent

name: Root-Cause Synthesis Service
purpose: reconstruct a full root-cause chain the instant an incident occurs
governance: incident-management policy; also draws on infrastructure state and decision history
success: root cause confirmed correct on human review

name: Software Implementation Service
purpose: deliver a working component satisfying agreed expectation
governance: coding standard, security policy
success: component satisfies architectural and functional specification

name: Solution Option Recommendation Service
purpose: compare candidate solution options against the business need and recommend the one delivering the greatest net value

service_level.label: Transparency and defensibility of comparison criteria
Full traceability from recommendation back to requirement

governance: investment/procurement governance policy, architecture standard where options are technical; also draws on the candidate solution options and a cost/risk/value estimate for each
success: sponsoring authority accepts the recommendation, or explicitly overrides it with documented rationale

name: Stakeholder Intent Reconciliation Service
purpose: keep requirement understanding synchronised with scattered, ongoing stakeholder signal
governance: requirements policy; draws on meetings, tickets, support conversations, and email; produces a continuously reconciled intent baseline
success: no stale intent baseline older than defined threshold

name: Standard Refinement Service
purpose: keep engineering standards current with accumulated evidence
governance: standards-governance policy; also draws on evidence from service delivery; output also includes a checklist and practice guidance alongside the revised standard
success: revised standard formally published

name: Standard Synthesis Service
purpose: draft or refine engineering standards directly from accumulating evidence
governance: standards-governance policy; draws on evidence from service delivery across the organisation
success: proposed revision formally adopted

name: System Model Service
purpose: represent structural and behavioural complexity before committing to design
governance: modelling standard; also draws on system/environment constraints
success: model reviewed and accepted as basis for architecture

name: Technical Documentation Service
purpose: keep an accurate, current representation of engineering knowledge
governance: documentation standard
success: documentation matches current system state

name: Threat Anticipation Service
purpose: check the organisation's own exposure the moment a new attack pattern emerges elsewhere
governance: security policy; also draws on external threat intelligence and the internal system inventory
success: exposure checked and mitigated before exploitation

name: Vendor Management Service
purpose: formally manage relationships with external vendors, suppliers and service providers
governance: procurement policy, third-party risk-management standard; also draws on vendor/supplier candidates, contractual requirements, and third-party risk criteria
success: vendor relationship delivers contracted value within acceptable risk, or is terminated per policy

name: Vulnerability Assessment Service
purpose: identify and reduce exposure to security threat
governance: security policy, regulatory obligation; also draws on system artefacts and current threat intelligence; also produces a policy enforcement record
success: no unmitigated critical vulnerability at release
